product_one_liner.value: PolyAI builds conversational AI agents for enterprises to handle and resolve complex customer-service conversations without escalation.

pricing_page.notes: The page describes per-minute pricing and included maintenance and support.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in customer case studies.

eng_blog.notes: Qualifying posts cover infrastructure by Principal Engineer Paul Annetts and voice-system architecture by CTO Shawn Wen.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes agent-building guides, integrations, an API reference, a quickstart and error-code documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists three openings: Staff Product Manager, Senior Marketing Manager EMEA, and Senior Account Manager; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: PolyAI proprietary models, including Raven 3.5 and Dialog-RSN-1; OpenAI; Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: Documentation recommends PolyAI Raven and also lists OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock options; its blog identifies Dialog-RSN-1 as a core dialog model.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly listed certifications and compliance claims; HIPAA and GDPR are not themselves certification schemes.

last_funding.notes: Latest reported round: Millionrounds lists an April 2026 $20M Series D based on a Companies House share-allotment filing, rather than a separately reported funding announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: PolyAI announced an $86M Series D on December 17, 2025, within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the three listed openings is an SDR, BDR or account executive role; the Senior Account Manager opening does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 6, 2026, PolyAI announced that Dialog-RSN-1 was available on AWS SageMaker.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: PolyAI announced Sunil Shah’s appointment as Chief Financial Officer on October 8, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named in PolyAI GTM systems job descriptions.
